chunks: 301 - Hisham ibn Salim narrated from Abu 'Abd Allah عليه السلام that he said:
"Trimming the nails on Friday grants protection from leprosy, insanity, vitiligo, and blindness. If you do not need to trim them, then scrape them lightly."

key_terms.تَقْلِيمُ: trimming or cutting, here referring to clipping the nails

ai.seo_question: What does the hadith say about trimming nails on Friday?
ai.summary: This hadith encourages trimming the nails on Friday as part of personal cleanliness and weekly etiquette. It presents this practice as a means of protection from certain afflictions, and even if trimming is unnecessary, it recommends lightly scraping or cleaning the nails.
